files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, transparent PNG. Create a precisely aligned 3 columns by 2 rows sheet of SIX SEPARATE isometric medieval European buildings. Canvas aspect ratio 3:2. Each equal square cell contains exactly ONE isolated complete building centered horizontally, entire silhouette including tiny contact shadow inside its cell, ample transparent margins, no overlapping cells. Row 1 left: small lord's stone keep with two short towers and slate-blue roofs, red pennant. Row 1 middle: cozy cream plaster and timber cottage with terracotta roof. Row 1 right: stone timber warehouse with broad doors, crates and blue roof. Row 2 left: woodcutter lodge with logs and axe chopping block, terracotta roof. Row 2 middle: sawmill carpentry workshop with a simple exposed timber saw bench and stacks of planks, slate roof. Row 2 right: square wheat farm plot with small timber shed, golden grain and fence. ALL exactly same fixed orthographic isometric camera, 2:1 ground diamond (camera elevation 30 degrees), front faces visible, same scale, building ground contact around lower central part of cell. Style warm charming handcrafted miniature medieval town, soft painterly 3D-rendered sprites, crisp readable shapes, subtle material detail, creamy stone, warm wood, muted greens, restrained terracotta and dusty blue. Gentle upper-left daylight. Actual transparent background, no ground square or scene or colored background behind buildings. No text, no letters, no UI, no borders, no watermarks, no grid lines. This is an asset atlas for a playable Godot city simulation, not a poster.
